source.text: ק֤וֹל שְׁמוּעָה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְרַ֥עַשׁ גָּד֖וֹל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה מְע֥וֹן תַּנִּֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [The] sound of a report! look, it is coming, and a great shaking from [the] land of [the] north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.

en.L: The sound of a report! Look, it is coming, \q and a great shaking from the land of the north, \q to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
en.B: Listen! A report! Here it comes: \q a great rumbling from the land of the north, \q to turn the cities of Judah into a wasteland, a haunt of jackals.
en.R: Listen! News is coming! \q A great army is thundering in from the north. \q It will turn the towns of Judah into ruins where only jackals live.

es.L: ¡Voz de rumor! He aquí que viene, \q y gran estremecimiento de la tierra del norte, \q para convertir las ciudades de Judá en desolación, en guarida de chacales.
es.B: ¡Atención! ¡Una noticia! Ya llega: \q un gran estruendo desde la tierra del norte, \q para convertir las ciudades de Judá en un desierto, en guarida de chacales.
es.R: ¡Atención! ¡Llegan noticias! \q Un gran ejército viene con estruendo desde el norte. \q Convertirá los pueblos de Judá en ruinas donde solo viven los chacales.

fr.L: Le bruit d’une nouvelle ! Voici, elle arrive, \q et un grand ébranlement du pays du nord, \q pour faire des villes de Juda une désolation, un repaire de chacals.
fr.B: Écoutez ! Une nouvelle ! La voici qui arrive : \q un grand grondement venu du pays du nord, \q pour faire des villes de Juda un désert, un repaire de chacals.
fr.R: Écoutez ! Des nouvelles arrivent ! \q Une grande armée arrive du nord dans un bruit de tonnerre. \q Elle va faire des villes de Juda des ruines où seuls les chacals vivront.

sw.L: Sauti ya habari! Tazama, inakuja, \q na tetemeko kuu kutoka nchi ya kaskazini, \q kuifanya miji ya Yuda ukiwa, makao ya mbweha.
sw.B: Sikiliza! Habari! Tazama inakuja: \q mshindo mkuu kutoka nchi ya kaskazini, \q kuigeuza miji ya Yuda kuwa jangwa, makao ya mbweha.
sw.R: Sikilizeni! Habari zinakuja! \q Jeshi kubwa linakuja kwa kishindo kutoka kaskazini. \q Litaigeuza miji ya Yuda kuwa magofu ambamo mbweha tu wanaishi.

vi.L: Có tiếng tin báo! Kìa, nó đang đến, \q một sự rung chuyển lớn từ xứ phương bắc, \q để làm cho các thành Giu-đa ra hoang vu, thành hang của chó rừng.
vi.B: Hãy nghe! Có tin báo! Kìa, nó đang đến: \q tiếng ầm ầm vang dội từ xứ phương bắc, \q để biến các thành Giu-đa thành hoang địa, thành hang ổ của chó rừng.
vi.R: Hãy nghe! Có tin đang đến! \q Một đạo quân lớn đang ầm ầm kéo đến từ phương bắc. \q Nó sẽ biến các thành Giu-đa thành đống đổ nát, chỉ có chó rừng sinh sống.

ko.L: 소문의 소리다! 보아라, 그것이 오고 있다. \q 북쪽 땅에서 큰 진동이 온다. \q 유다의 성읍들을 황무지로, 승냥이들의 소굴로 만들려는 것이다.
ko.B: 들어라! 소식이다! 그것이 다가온다. \q 북쪽 땅에서 크게 땅을 울리며 온다. \q 유다의 성읍들을 황무지로, 승냥이들의 소굴로 만들려는 것이다.
ko.R: 들어라! 소식이 온다! \q 큰 군대가 북쪽에서 땅을 울리며 쳐들어온다. \q 그 군대가 유다의 성읍들을 승냥이만 사는 폐허로 만들 것이다.

pt.L: O som de uma notícia! Eis que vem, \q e um grande tremor da terra do norte, \q para fazer das cidades de Judá uma desolação, covil de chacais.
pt.B: Escutem! Uma notícia! Aí vem ela: \q um grande estrondo da terra do norte, \q para fazer das cidades de Judá um deserto, toca de chacais.
pt.R: Escutem! Uma notícia está chegando! \q Um grande exército vem trovejando do norte. \q Vai transformar as cidades de Judá em ruínas onde só vivem chacais.

am.L: የወሬ ድምፅ! እነሆ፣ ይመጣል፤ \q ከሰሜንም ምድር ታላቅ መናወጥ፤ \q የይሁዳን ከተሞች ባድማ፣ የቀበሮዎች ጉድጓድ ለማድረግ።
am.B: ስሙ! ወሬ! ይኸው እየመጣ ነው፤ \q ከሰሜን ምድር ታላቅ ድምድምታ፤ \q የይሁዳን ከተሞች ባድማ፣ የቀበሮዎችም ዋሻ ሊያደርግ።
am.R: ስሙ! ወሬ እየመጣ ነው! \q ታላቅ ሠራዊት ከሰሜን እያስገመገመ ይመጣል። \q የይሁዳን ከተሞች ቀበሮዎች ብቻ የሚኖሩባቸው ፍርስራሾች ያደርጋቸዋል።

hi.L: समाचार का शब्द! देखो, वह आ रहा है, \q और उत्तर देश से एक बड़ा कोलाहल, \q कि यहूदा के नगरों को उजाड़, गीदड़ों की माँद बना दे।
hi.B: सुनो! एक समाचार! देखो, वह आ रहा है: \q उत्तर देश से एक बड़ी गड़गड़ाहट, \q कि यहूदा के नगरों को उजाड़ और गीदड़ों का बसेरा बना दे।
hi.R: सुनो! ख़बर आ रही है! \q उत्तर से एक बड़ी सेना गरजती हुई आ रही है। \q वह यहूदा के नगरों को ऐसे खंडहर बना देगी जहाँ केवल गीदड़ रहते हैं।

ru.L: Звук вести! Вот, она идёт, \q и великое сотрясение из северной земли, \q чтобы сделать города Иуды пустошью, логовом шакалов.
ru.B: Слушайте! Весть! Вот она приходит: \q великий гул из северной страны, \q чтобы превратить города Иуды в пустошь, в логово шакалов.
ru.R: Слушайте! Идёт весть! \q С грохотом надвигается с севера огромное войско. \q Оно превратит города Иуды в развалины, где будут жить только шакалы.

ja.L: 知らせの声だ！なんと、それはやって来る。 \q 北の地からの大きなとどろきが。 \q ユダの町々を荒れ地とし、ジャッカルの住みかとするために。
ja.B: 聞きなさい、知らせだ！それはやって来る。 \q 北の地から、大きなとどろきが。 \q ユダの町々を荒れ地とし、ジャッカルのねぐらとするために。
ja.R: 聞きなさい！知らせが来る！ \q 大軍が、北から地響きを立ててやって来る。 \q 敵はユダの町々を、ジャッカルしか住まない廃墟にする。

uk.L: Голос звістки! Ось вона йде, \q і великий гуркіт із північної землі, \q щоб зробити міста Юдеї пусткою, лігвом шакалів.
uk.B: Слухайте! Звістка! Ось вона надходить: \q великий гуркіт із північного краю, \q щоб обернути міста Юдеї на пустку, на житло шакалів.
uk.R: Слухайте! Надходить звістка! \q Велике військо з гуркотом іде з півночі. \q Воно оберне міста Юдеї на руїни, де живуть лише шакали.

decisions.choice: the sound of a report: listen, news!
decisions.reason: "Sound of ..." at the start of a cry is a call to listen (3:21; Isaiah 40:3). The report is news of the army on its way.

decisions.choice: a great shaking: the rumble of an army on the march
decisions.reason: The word means a quaking or roar, used of chariots and marching troops (47:3; Nahum 3:2).

decisions.choice: the land of the north: Babylon, whose armies came from the north
decisions.reason: Armies from Mesopotamia came into Judah by the northern road. Jeremiah's warnings of the enemy from the north (1:14; 4:6; 6:1, 22) were fulfilled by Babylon.

decisions.choice: a desolation, a lair of jackals: as in 9:10
decisions.reason: The same words describe the ruin of Jerusalem and Judah in 9:10. Ruined towns are left to wild animals (49:33; Isaiah 34:13).

decisions.choice: A great army is thundering in
decisions.reason: Readable says what the great shaking is (meaning decisions m2 and m3).

decisions.choice: "ジャッカルの住みか" (L), "ジャッカルのねぐら" (B), as 9:10 (m4); hinneh in a report "なんと" (L).
decisions.reason: Repeated phrase as 9:10.

source.text: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָאָדָ֖ם דַּרְכּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־לְאִ֣ישׁ הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְהָכִ֖ין אֶֽת־צַעֲדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: I know, Yahweh, that not to man [is] his way; not to a man walking and to direct his step.

en.L: I know, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q that not to {{gender:a human being|man}} [belongs] {{gender:their|his}} way; \q not to {{gender:one|a man}} who walks [does it belong] to direct {{gender:their|his}} steps.
en.B: I know, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q that {{gender:a person's|a man's}} way is not in {{gender:their|his}} own hands; \q no one who walks can set the course of {{gender:their|his}} own steps.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I know that people are not in control of their own lives. \q They cannot decide where their steps will lead.

es.L: Sé, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q que no es del hombre su camino; \q ni del que anda es el dirigir sus pasos.
es.B: Yo sé, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q que el camino de una persona no está en sus propias manos; \q nadie que camina puede dirigir sus propios pasos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, yo sé que las personas no tienen el control de su propia vida. \q No pueden decidir adónde las llevarán sus pasos.

fr.L: Je sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q que ce n’est pas à l’{{gender:être humain|homme}} [qu’appartient] sa voie ; \q ce n’est pas à celui qui marche de diriger ses pas.
fr.B: Je sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q que le chemin de l’{{gender:être humain|homme}} n’est pas entre ses mains ; \q celui qui marche ne peut pas diriger lui-même ses pas.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je sais que les gens ne sont pas maîtres de leur vie. \q Ils ne peuvent pas décider où leurs pas les mèneront.

sw.L: Ninajua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwamba njia ya mwanadamu si yake mwenyewe; \q si ya mtu anayetembea kuziongoza hatua zake.
sw.B: Ninajua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwamba njia ya mtu haiko mikononi mwake mwenyewe; \q hakuna mtu anayetembea awezaye kuziongoza hatua zake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninajua kwamba watu hawawezi kuyaongoza maisha yao wenyewe. \q Hawawezi kuamua hatua zao zitawapeleka wapi.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, con biết \q rằng đường lối của con người không thuộc về người ấy; \q người đang đi cũng không [có quyền] định hướng bước chân mình.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, con biết \q rằng đường đời của con người không nằm trong tay họ; \q không ai đang bước đi mà tự định hướng được bước chân mình.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, con biết rằng con người không làm chủ được đời mình. \q Họ không thể quyết định bước chân mình sẽ dẫn đến đâu.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 압니다. \q 사람의 길이 그 자신에게 [속하지] 않고, \q 걷는 사람이 자기 걸음을 정하는 것이 [그에게 속하지] 않는다는 것을.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 압니다. \q 사람의 길은 그 자신의 손에 달려 있지 않고, \q 걸어가는 사람이 스스로 자기 걸음을 정할 수 없다는 것을.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 압니다. 사람은 자기 삶을 마음대로 할 수 없습니다. \q 사람은 자기 걸음이 어디로 갈지 스스로 정할 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Eu sei, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q que {{gender:ao ser humano|ao homem}} não [pertence] o seu caminho; \q não [cabe] a quem anda firmar os seus passos.
pt.B: Eu sei, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q que ninguém é dono do próprio caminho; \q quem anda não pode traçar o rumo dos seus passos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu sei que as pessoas não controlam a própria vida. \q Elas não podem decidir aonde os seus passos vão levar.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አውቃለሁ፤ \q የሰው መንገድ ለራሱ እንዳልሆነ፤ \q ለሚሄድም ሰው አካሄዱን ማቅናት ለእርሱ እንዳልሆነ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አውቃለሁ፤ \q የሰው መንገድ በራሱ እጅ አይደለም፤ \q የሚሄድ ማንም ሰው የእርምጃውን አቅጣጫ ሊወስን አይችልም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን በራሳቸው እንደማይመሩ አውቃለሁ። \q እርምጃቸው ወዴት እንደሚወስዳቸው ሊወስኑ አይችሉም።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जानता हूँ \q कि मनुष्य का मार्ग उसके अपने वश में नहीं; \q चलनेवाले मनुष्य के वश में नहीं कि वह अपने क़दमों को ठहराए।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जानता हूँ \q कि मनुष्य का मार्ग उसके अपने हाथ में नहीं है; \q चलनेवाला कोई भी अपने क़दमों की दिशा तय नहीं कर सकता।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जानता हूँ कि लोगों का अपने जीवन पर वश नहीं है। \q वे तय नहीं कर सकते कि उनके क़दम उन्हें कहाँ ले जाएँगे।

ru.L: Знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q что не во власти человека путь его; \q не во власти идущего направлять свои шаги.
ru.B: Знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q что путь человека не в его руках; \q никто, идущий по пути, не может сам направить свои шаги.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я знаю, что люди не управляют своей жизнью. \q Они не могут решать, куда приведут их шаги.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは知っている。 \q 人の道は、その人自身のものではなく、 \q 歩む者が、自分の歩みを定めることもできないことを。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは知っている。 \q 人の道は、その人自身の手の中にはなく、 \q 歩む者は、だれも自分の歩みを定めることができないことを。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは知っている。人は自分の人生を思いどおりにはできない。 \q 自分の歩みがどこへ向かうのかを、決めることはできない。

uk.L: Я знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, \q що не людині [належить] її дорога; \q не тому, хто ходить, [належить] спрямовувати свої кроки.
uk.B: Я знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, \q що дорога людини не в її власних руках; \q ніхто, хто ходить, не може сам визначити напрям своїх кроків.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я знаю, що люди не владні над власним життям. \q Вони не можуть вирішити, куди приведуть їх їхні кроки.

decisions.choice: the speaker prays to God
decisions.reason: The voice of verses 19-20 now turns to God in prayer. Verses 23-25 are a prayer for the people, spoken as by the prophet on their behalf.

decisions.choice: a person's way is not their own: the course of a life is not in human control
decisions.reason: "Way" is the course of a life, and "steps" the path taken. Humans cannot steer their own lives; God directs them (Proverbs 16:9; 20:24). The prayer admits this, and so asks for God's correction rather than his anger (verse 24).

decisions.choice: man: any human being
decisions.reason: The two words mean a human being and a person; the saying is about everyone, men and women.

decisions.choice: gender spans
decisions.reason: Since the saying is about anyone (meaning decision m3), the inclusive wording is the default and "man" the alternative. Readable uses "people", which needs no alternative.

decisions.choice: "el hombre" (L); "una persona" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hombre" in this saying means any human being, and "su" serves for men and women, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: mwanadamu, mtu, yake (no gender span)
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" and "mtu" are any human being and "yake" is his or her alike, so the English gender spans have no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "l’être humain" (alternative "l’homme"); "celui qui marche ... ses pas" without a span
decisions.reason: The noun takes the gender setting; "celui qui" and "ses" are already generic in French, so the English spans on "their / his" have no French counterpart.

decisions.choice: the people pray as one: "con"
decisions.reason: Verses 23-25 are a prayer spoken for the people as one person (meaning decision on verse 24), so the speaker says "con" to God, as the terms note sets for prayer. Vietnamese "con người" and "người" include men and women, so the English gender spans are not needed.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's prayer in 합쇼체 with 저/제, and no gender span
alternatives: | Verses 23-25 are the prophet's prayer for his people and take the speech of prayer; Korean 사람 already covers men and women, so the gender spans of the English have no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: não pertence o seu caminho ... firmar os seus passos (L); ninguém é dono do próprio caminho ... traçar o rumo (B)
alternatives: não está nas mãos do homem
decisions.reason: The verse is well known in Portuguese in wording this translation does not copy; each level is drafted from the Hebrew (m2). The verb for the steps means to make firm or set in order, so Literal says "firmar" and Balanced "traçar o rumo". The saying is about anyone (m3): Literal keeps the gender setting on the noun Portuguese has to choose; Balanced says "ninguém" and "quem", which already include everyone, and so needs no setting where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्य", "अपने", no gender spans
decisions.reason: Hindi "मनुष्य" means any human being and the reflexive "अपने" has no gender, so the English spans have no second Hindi wording; "उसके" is the ordinary generic pronoun.

decisions.choice: no gender spans
decisions.reason: The English Literal and Balanced have gender spans for "a human being / man" and "their / his". "Человек", "его" after it and the reflexive "свои" already speak of anyone, so Russian needs none.

decisions.choice: "人", "その人自身", "歩む者", "自分" with no gender spans, where the English L and B have spans on human / their: Japanese is already inclusive.
decisions.reason: Style guide 7a.

source.text: יַסְּרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ־בְּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ֖ פֶּן־תַּמְעִטֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Correct me, Yahweh, only in justice, not in your anger, lest you make me few.

en.L: Correct me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, but with justice; \q not in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger, lest {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make me few.
en.B: Correct me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, but in just measure, \q not in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger, or {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will bring me to nothing.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, correct me, but be fair. \q Do not punish me in anger, or there will be nothing left of me.

es.L: Corrígeme, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, pero con justicia; \q no con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira, no sea que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reduzcas a poco.
es.B: Corrígeme, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, pero con medida justa, \q no con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira, o {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reducirás a nada.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, corrígeme, pero sé justo. \q No me castigues con ira, o no quedará nada de mí.

fr.L: Corrige-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais avec justice ; \q pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, de peur que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne me réduises à peu de chose.
fr.B: Corrige-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais avec mesure, \q pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, sinon {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me réduirais à rien.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, corrige-moi, mais sois juste. \q Ne me punis pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, sinon il ne restera plus rien de moi.

sw.L: Unirudi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini kwa haki; \q si kwa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, usije ukanifanya kuwa mdogo.
sw.B: Unirudi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini kwa kipimo cha haki, \q si kwa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, la sivyo utanifanya kuwa si kitu.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unirekebishe, lakini kwa haki. \q Usiniadhibu kwa hasira, la sivyo hakuna kitu kitakachobaki kwangu.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin sửa phạt con, nhưng theo lẽ công bình; \q chớ trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho con ra hư không.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin sửa phạt con, nhưng cách chừng mực công bình, \q đừng trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho con tiêu mất.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin sửa phạt con, nhưng xin công bằng. \q Xin đừng trừng phạt con trong cơn giận, kẻo con chẳng còn lại gì.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡아 주시되 공의로 해 주십시오. \q 주님의 진노로 하지 마십시오. 그러면 주님께서 저를 보잘것없게 만드실 것입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡아 주시되 알맞게 해 주십시오. \q 노하셔서 하지는 마십시오. 그러면 주님께서 저를 없애 버리실 것입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡아 주시되 공정하게 해 주십시오. \q 노하셔서 벌하지는 마십시오. 그러면 저는 아무것도 남지 않을 것입니다.

pt.L: Corrige-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, mas com justiça; \q não na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não me reduzas a pouco.
pt.B: Corrige-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, mas na medida justa, \q não na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira, senão {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me reduzirás a nada.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, corrige-me, mas com justiça. \q Não me castigues com ira, senão não vai sobrar nada de mim.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ገሥጸኝ፤ ነገር ግን በፍርድ ይሁን፤ \q በቁጣህ አይሁን፤ እንዳታሳንሰኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ገሥጸኝ፤ ነገር ግን በልክ ይሁን፤ \q በቁጣህ አይሁን፤ አለዚያ ከንቱ ታደርገኛለህ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ገሥጸኝ፤ ነገር ግን ፍትሐዊ ሁን። \q በቁጣ አትቅጣኝ፤ አለዚያ ምንም አልቀርም።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे सुधार, पर न्याय से; \q अपने क्रोध में नहीं, कहीं ऐसा न हो कि तू मुझे घटा दे।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे सुधार, पर उचित मात्रा में; \q अपने क्रोध में नहीं, नहीं तो तू मुझे मिटा देगा।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे सुधार, पर न्याय से। \q क्रोध में आकर मुझे दंड न दे, नहीं तो मेरा कुछ भी नहीं बचेगा।

ru.L: Вразумляй меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, но по правосудию; \q не в гневе {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}}, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не умалил меня.
ru.B: Исправляй меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, но в справедливой мере, \q не в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} гневе, иначе {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сведёшь меня на нет.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, исправляй меня, но будь справедлив. \q Не наказывай меня в гневе, иначе от меня ничего не останется.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを懲らしめてほしい。ただ、正しい裁きをもって。 \q あなたの怒りによってではなく。あなたがわたしを小さくしてしまわないように。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを懲らしめてほしい。しかし、ほどよい裁きをもって。 \q 怒りをもってではなく。さもないと、あなたはわたしを無に帰してしまわれる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを正してほしい。でも、公平にしてほしい。 \q 怒ってわたしを罰しないでほしい。そうでないと、わたしは何も残らなくなってしまう。

uk.L: Напоумлюй мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, але за правосуддям; \q не у {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} гніві, щоб {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не зменшив мене.
uk.B: Напоумлюй мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, але в справедливій мірі, \q не у {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} гніві, а то {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} обернеш мене на ніщо.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, виправляй мене, але справедливо. \q Не карай мене в гніві, бо від мене нічого не залишиться.

decisions.choice: correct: discipline, as a father his child
decisions.reason: The verb means to train by correction and punishment (2:19; 31:18; Proverbs 3:11-12). The prayer accepts discipline but asks that it not destroy.

decisions.choice: with justice: in fair measure
decisions.reason: "Justice" here is right measure, a limit set by what is fair. God later promises to correct his people "with justice" and not wipe them out (30:11; 46:28).

decisions.choice: me: the people speaking as one
decisions.reason: The "me" is the nation, as in verses 19-20, spoken for by the prophet.

decisions.choice: not in your anger: as in Psalm 6:2 and 38:2
decisions.reason: The psalms of lament ask in the same words that God not correct in his anger.

decisions.choice: make me few: reduce me to almost nothing
decisions.reason: The verb means to make small or few. Under God's full anger the nation would be cut down until little or nothing was left (Ezekiel 29:15).

decisions.choice: in just measure ... bring me to nothing (Balanced); be fair ... nothing left of me (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of meaning decisions m2 and m5 in plain words.

decisions.choice: "Вразумляй ... не в гневе твоём"
decisions.reason: The verb and the phrase of Psalm 6:2 in this translation, which the meaning decision names.

decisions.choice: The prayer in verse (10:23-25, the people as one, m3) asks with "〜てほしい" / "〜ないでほしい", plain at every level, as the PROPHETIC CONVENTIONS for requests to God in an oracle, not the "〜てください" of the Psalms; yassereni "懲らしめてほしい" (L, B), "正してほしい" (R).
decisions.reason: The prophetic register holds in Jeremiah's verse.

source.text: שְׁפֹ֣ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֗ עַל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יְדָע֔וּךָ וְעַל֙ מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּשִׁמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א קָרָ֑אוּ כִּֽי־אָכְל֣וּ אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַאֲכָלֻ֨הוּ֙ וַיְכַלֻּ֔הוּ וְאֶת־נָוֵ֖הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Pour out your wrath on the nations that not know you, and on clans that on your name not call; for they have devoured Jacob, and devoured him and consumed him, and his pasture they have laid waste.

en.L: Pour out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath on the nations that do not know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and on [the] clans \q that do not call on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name; \q for they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him and consumed him, \q and his pasture they have laid waste.
en.B: Pour out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury on the nations that have not known {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q on the peoples \q that never call on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. \q For they have swallowed up Jacob, swallowed him and finished him off, \q and left his homeland desolate.
en.R: Pour out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger on the nations that do not know {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Pour it out on the peoples that do not worship {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q They have destroyed Jacob's people; they have swallowed them up and finished them off. \q They have ruined the land where they lived.

es.L: Derrama {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira sobre las naciones que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conocen, \q y sobre [las] familias \q que no invocan {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre; \q porque han devorado a Jacob; lo han devorado y lo han consumido, \q y su pastizal han asolado.
es.B: Derrama {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor sobre las naciones que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} han conocido, \q sobre los pueblos \q que nunca invocan {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. \q Porque se han tragado a Jacob, se lo han tragado y han acabado con él, \q y han dejado desolada su tierra.
es.R: Derrama {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enojo sobre las naciones que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conocen. \q Derrámalo sobre los pueblos que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} adoran. \q Han destruido al pueblo de Jacob; se lo han tragado y han acabado con él. \q Han arruinado la tierra donde vivían.

fr.L: Déverse {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur sur les nations qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} connaissent pas, \q et sur [les] clans \q qui n’invoquent pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ; \q car ils ont dévoré Jacob ; ils l’ont dévoré et consumé, \q et ils ont dévasté son pâturage.
fr.B: Répands {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur sur les nations qui ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont pas connu, \q sur les peuples \q qui n’invoquent jamais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. \q Car ils ont englouti Jacob, ils l’ont englouti et achevé, \q et ils ont dévasté sa patrie.
fr.R: Déverse {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère sur les nations qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} connaissent pas. \q Déverse-la sur les peuples qui ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adorent pas. \q Ils ont détruit le peuple de Jacob ; ils l’ont englouti et achevé. \q Ils ont ravagé le pays où il vivait.

sw.L: Imwage ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu ya mataifa yasiyokujua {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q na juu ya koo \q zisizoliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; \q kwa maana wamemla Yakobo; wamemla na kummaliza, \q na malisho yake wameyafanya ukiwa.
sw.B: Imwage hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kali juu ya mataifa ambayo hayajakujua {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q juu ya jamaa za watu \q zisizoliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kamwe. \q Kwa maana wamemmeza Yakobo, wamemmeza na kummaliza, \q na kuiacha nchi yake ikiwa ukiwa.
sw.R: Imwage hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu ya mataifa yasiyokujua {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Imwage juu ya watu wasiokuabudu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Wamewaangamiza watu wa Yakobo; wamewameza na kuwamaliza. \q Wameiharibu nchi waliyoishi.

vi.L: Xin đổ cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các dân tộc không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và trên các gia tộc \q không kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì chúng đã ăn nuốt Gia-cốp; chúng đã ăn nuốt người và tiêu diệt người, \q và đã làm cho đồng cỏ người ra hoang vu.
vi.B: Xin đổ cơn phẫn nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các dân tộc không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q trên các dân \q chẳng hề kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Vì chúng đã nuốt chửng Gia-cốp, nuốt chửng và tiêu diệt người, \q và làm cho quê hương người ra hoang tàn.
vi.R: Xin đổ cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các dân tộc không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin đổ cơn giận ấy trên các dân không thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng đã hủy diệt dân của Gia-cốp; chúng đã nuốt chửng và tiêu diệt họ. \q Chúng đã tàn phá xứ sở nơi họ sinh sống.

ko.L: 주님을 알지 못하는 민족들 위에 \q 주님의 이름을 부르지 않는 \q 족속들 위에 주님의 진노를 쏟으십시오. \q 그들이 야곱을 삼켰습니다. 그들이 그를 삼키고 멸했으며, \q 그의 목장을 황폐하게 했습니다.
ko.B: 주님을 알지 못하는 민족들에게, \q 주님의 이름을 부르지 않는 \q 족속들에게 주님의 진노를 쏟으십시오. \q 그들이 야곱을 집어삼켰습니다. 그를 집어삼켜 끝장내고 \q 그의 삶의 터전을 폐허로 만들었습니다.
ko.R: 주님을 알지 못하는 민족들에게 주님의 분노를 쏟으십시오. \q 주님을 섬기지 않는 백성들에게 그것을 쏟으십시오. \q 그들이 야곱 백성을 멸망시켰습니다. 그들을 삼켜 버리고 끝장냈습니다. \q 그들이 살던 땅을 망쳐 놓았습니다.

pt.L: Derrama o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} furor sobre as nações que não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conhecem, \q e sobre [os] clãs \q que não invocam o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome; \q pois devoraram Jacó; devoraram-no e o consumiram, \q e a sua pastagem devastaram.
pt.B: Derrama a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira sobre as nações que não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conheceram, \q sobre os povos \q que nunca invocam o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome. \q Pois engoliram Jacó, engoliram-no e acabaram com ele, \q e deixaram desolada a sua terra.
pt.R: Derrama a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira sobre as nações que não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} conhecem. \q Derrama-a sobre os povos que não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} adoram. \q Eles destruíram o povo de Jacó; engoliram esse povo e acabaram com ele. \q Arruinaram a terra onde eles moravam.

am.L: መዓትህን በማያውቁህ ሕዝቦች ላይ፣ \q በወገኖችም ላይ \q ስምህን በማይጠሩት ላይ አፍስስ፤ \q ያዕቆብን በልተዋልና፤ በልተውታል፤ ፈጽመውም አጥፍተውታል፤ \q መሰማሪያውንም አፈራርሰዋልና።
am.B: ቁጣህን ባላወቁህ ሕዝቦች ላይ አፍስስ፤ \q በወገኖችም ላይ፣ \q ስምህን ከቶ በማይጠሩት ላይ። \q ያዕቆብን ውጠውታልና፤ ውጠው ፈጽመውታል፤ \q አገሩንም ባድማ አድርገዋልና።
am.R: ቁጣህን በማያውቁህ ሕዝቦች ላይ አፍስስ። \q በማያመልኩህ ወገኖች ላይ አፍስሰው። \q የያዕቆብን ሕዝብ አጥፍተዋል፤ ውጠው ጨርሰዋቸዋል። \q የሚኖሩበትንም ምድር አበላሽተዋል።

hi.L: अपना कोप उन जातियों पर उँडेल दे जो तुझे नहीं जानतीं, \q और [उन] कुलों पर \q जो तेरे नाम को नहीं पुकारते; \q क्योंकि उन्होंने याकूब को खा लिया है; उन्होंने उसे खा लिया और उसका अंत कर दिया है, \q और उसकी चराई को उन्होंने उजाड़ दिया है।
hi.B: अपना प्रकोप उन राष्ट्रों पर उँडेल दे जिन्होंने तुझे नहीं जाना, \q उन लोगों पर \q जो कभी तेरा नाम नहीं पुकारते। \q क्योंकि उन्होंने याकूब को निगल लिया है, उसे निगलकर समाप्त कर दिया है, \q और उसके निवास-देश को उजाड़ दिया है।
hi.R: अपना क्रोध उन देशों पर उँडेल दे जो तुझे नहीं जानते। \q उसे उन लोगों पर उँडेल दे जो तेरी आराधना नहीं करते। \q उन्होंने याकूब के लोगों को नष्ट कर दिया है; उन्होंने उन्हें निगलकर समाप्त कर दिया है। \q उन्होंने उस देश को उजाड़ दिया है जहाँ वे रहते थे।

ru.L: Излей свою ярость на народы, которые не знают {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, \q и на роды, \q которые не призывают {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени; \q потому что они пожрали Иакова, пожрали его и истребили его, \q и его пастбище опустошили.
ru.B: Обрушь свой гнев на народы, которые {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} не познали, \q на племена, \q которые никогда не призывают {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя. \q Ведь они поглотили Иакова, поглотили и покончили с ним, \q и разорили его родной край.
ru.R: Излей свой гнев на народы, которые не знают {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. \q Излей его на племена, которые не поклоняются {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. \q Они уничтожили народ Иакова; они проглотили его и покончили с ним. \q Они разорили землю, где он жил.

ja.L: あなたを知らない国々の上に、あなたの憤りを注いでほしい。 \q また、もろもろの氏族、 \q あなたの名を呼び求めない[氏族]の上に。 \q 彼らはヤコブを食らい、食らい尽くし、滅ぼし尽くし、 \q その牧場を荒らしたからだ。
ja.B: あなたを知らない国々の上に、あなたの激しい怒りを注いでほしい。 \q また、もろもろの民、 \q あなたの名を決して呼び求めない民の上に。 \q 彼らはヤコブを飲み尽くし、飲み込んで、滅ぼし尽くし、 \q その住む地を荒れ果てさせたからだ。
ja.R: あなたを知らない国々の上に、あなたの怒りを注いでほしい。 \q あなたを礼拝しない国々の上に、怒りを注いでほしい。 \q 彼らはヤコブの民を滅ぼし、飲み込んで、すっかり滅ぼしてしまった。 \q その民が住んでいた土地を荒らしてしまったのだ。

uk.L: Вилий {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} лють на народи, які не знають {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, \q і на роди, \q що не кличуть {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені; \q бо вони пожерли Якова; вони пожерли його і знищили його, \q і його пасовисько спустошили.
uk.B: Вилий {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} лють на народи, які не знали {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, \q на племена, \q що ніколи не кличуть {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені. \q Бо вони поглинули Якова, поглинули й винищили його, \q і спустошили його рідну землю.
uk.R: Вилий {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} гнів на народи, які не знають {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. \q Вилий його на племена, які не поклоняються {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}. \q Вони знищили народ Якова; вони поглинули його й покінчили з ним. \q Вони зруйнували землю, де він жив.

decisions.choice: the words of Psalm 79:6-7
decisions.reason: The verse is almost the same as Psalm 79:6-7, and that psalm's wording is used here. The differences: Jeremiah has "clans" where the psalm has "kingdoms"; Jeremiah's "for they have devoured" is plural where the psalm's is singular; and Jeremiah adds "they have devoured him and consumed him".

decisions.choice: clans: the families and peoples of the earth
decisions.reason: The word means a clan or extended family and is used for the peoples of the world (Genesis 12:3; Amos 3:2).

decisions.choice: know you ... call on your name: acknowledge and worship God
decisions.reason: To know God is to acknowledge him and belong to him, not just to know about him; to call on his name is to pray to him and worship him (Psalm 79:6; Genesis 12:8).

decisions.choice: pour out your wrath on the nations
decisions.reason: Having asked to be corrected with justice and not in anger (verse 24), the prayer asks that God's anger fall instead on the nations that destroy his people, who do not know him at all.

decisions.choice: Jacob ... his pasture: the people of Israel and their land
decisions.reason: Jacob stands for the nation descended from him. The word for "pasture" is the place where a flock settles, and so a home; the people are God's flock (verse 21).

decisions.choice: peoples
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "peoples" for "clans", since the word here means whole peoples, not small family groups (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: worship you; Jacob's people; the land where they lived
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 79:6-7, Readable says what calling on God's name means and who Jacob stands for (meaning decisions m3 and m5).

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 79:6-7
